# NCT05704647 
 
Status: RECRUITING | Phase: PHASE2 | Study Type: INTERVENTIONAL | Sponsor: M.D. Anderson Cancer Center 
 
Title: Phase II Study of Nivolumab in Combination With Relatlimab in Patients With Active Melanoma Brain Metastases 
Target Enrollment: 30 
Eligible Ages: 18 Years to Any age 
Start Date: 2023-02-23 | Completion Date: 2028-07-31 
Source: ClinicalTrials.gov 
 
## Conditions (ClinicalTrials.gov) 
- Melanoma (Skin) 
 
## Interventions (ClinicalTrials.gov) 
- BMS-986213 (Relatlimab-Nivolumab FDC) *(DRUG)* (also known as: Relatlimab, BMS-986016) 
- Nivolumab *(DRUG)* 
- Relatlimab *(DRUG)* 
 
## Summary (ClinicalTrials.gov) 
 
To learn if giving nivolumab in combination with relatlimab can help to control melanoma that has spread to the brain (melanoma with brain metastases). The safety and side effects of the study drug combination will also be studied.
